Great place, dear hostess, arranges everything for, private tour Ha Chiang Loop with easyrider for wife and own motorbike
Dec 2025 • Couples
Nice quiet place with lovely pool, fantastic breakfast, bread with fried egg delicious on terrace in the garden, great reception by lovely hostess Nguyen, who had arranged taxi from bus station; she arranged for us the Ha Giang Loop for 3 days with two home stay nights with great views and the fantastic guide Hyan, who took us to places where the big tours did not come, including visit to his grandparents home, where we were welcomed with tea and left with bottle of homemade cornwine, on return by Nguyen spoiled with hot foot bath, this is highly recommended for anyone who loves pampering and personal attention

By far the best place we stayed in Vietnam
Dec 2019 • Family
We stayed in Ha Giang Historic House. It is a family run hotel, and we felt as a part of the family! We had an authentic and delicious family dinner with them twice. Their daughters were so friendly and played with our children and we really had a great time here.
The room was super clean and the mountain view was beautiful and relaxing. 
When we had to move on we didn’t find that genuine kindness in other places in Vietnam.
Couldn’t recommend this place highly enough!

Quiet and peaceful surroundings
Dec 2019 • Family
We are glad to have chosen Ha Giang Historic House for our stay. The entire place is just quiet, peaceful and cozy. We had booked 2 twin rooms and 1 triple room, the rooms are clean, huge and the beds are huge too. Except for the bathroom, it's kinda small. The one thing I don't quite understand is why most Vietnam bathroom layout cannot separate shower and toilet area with a kerb or curtain or whatever to prevent the entire floor from getting wet. 

We had our dinner at Historic House, they offered two choices, Vietnamese or Western so of course we go for Vietnamese. It cost 200000vnd per person. The portion was big and the food taste good, we had so much to eat.

Breakfast was good too, they had bread, egg noodle soup, pancake with banana to choose from.

The location is also not too bad, convenience stores and restaurants within walking distance.

The people at Historic House are also very friendly so highly recommended place to stay if you are travelling in Ha Giang.
